speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. You are here for evaluation regarding your postpartum fever and abdominal tenderness; how many days postpartum are you, and what is your highest recorded temperature? To begin our assessment, please tell me if you have experienced any foul-smelling lochia, and did you have an episiotomy or perineal tears during delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Uterine Infection (Endometritis) with possible Urinary Tract Involvement.

I have gathered sufficient information to proceed with a definitive diagnosis based on your postpartum status, uterine tenderness, and prolonged labor history.
